title.narrative: for support of the Byllye Avery Sexual and Reproductive Justice Endowed Professorship

description.narrative: The core mission of the Sexual and Reproductive Justice Hub at CUNY Graduate School of Public Health and Health Policy (CUNY SPH) is to advocate for policy and action that advances social justice and improves health outcomes for all. This grant will support the establishment of the Byllye Avery Sexual and Reproductive Justice Endowed Professorship at CUNY SPH in support of associated activities there.
